messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a shepherded swap during quiet window tonight 23:00 UTC. Affects API -> runtime -> router -> console. Hoping to do a dry-run at 22:30 first.
kevin: +1. Can you paste the exact pin order and rollforward cutoff?
maria: pin order: api v3.2.1 -> runtime v4.0.0-rc2 -> router v2.8.0 -> console v1.14. Pin & verify each wave before the next.
deploy-bot: dry-run created by @maria for 1765554322. Waves: [api,runtime,router,console]. Dry-run at 2025-03-18T22:30:00Z.
tim: On rollback criteria — propose: 5xx rate >0.5% for 3m OR p50 latency regression > 150ms vs baseline for 5m. If triggered, rollback last wave only, unless multiple waves fail.
sophia: Are there schema changes in console? last-minute front-end toggles?
maria: console change is UI-only flagging, no DB migration. No schema for this deploy.
kevin: What about KV cache invalidation on runtime hop? Need to confirm KV TTL and sticky sessions.
ops-oncall: I will watch KV eviction metrics and route error spikes. Pager enabled.
maria: runbook snippet pasted:```steps:
1) Dry-run on staging at 22:30 (deploy-bot dry-run)
2) During quiet window 23:00 start wave-1 (api)
3) Verify health: 200s, latency, error budget
4) Pin api -> if ok proceed to runtime
5) If error -> rollback api and halt
```
kevin: For the runtime step include: `kubectl annotate pods redwood-runtime rollout-pin=manual` before swap to prevent auto-evict.
maria: noted. Also we'll use traffic-steer 10% -> 50% -> 100% ramp for router to reduce blast radius.
deploy-bot: preflight checks: model-compat OK, canary pods healthy, route-matcher sanity OK.
sophia: quick note — QA will smoke the main customer flows at +5m after each wave. @ops-oncall please ack.
ops-oncall: acked. I'll attach dashboards and run grep alerts for `router_error` and `kv_eviction_rate`.
tim: Last call: who has rollback rights?
kevin: Ops and release lead (maria) can trigger rollback. I'll standby to assist.
maria: thanks. If no objections I'll kick dry-run at 22:30 and post results here. :shipit: :eyes:
